format: Ballroom competitions (organizer duty after the event)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.section: III.E After the Event, item 2 (printed p.25)
source.quote_free_summary: The organizer must keep the adjudicators' original score sheets for at least thirty days after the event closes, for use if the scrutineers' final markings are in doubt.

requirement: Competition OS must not destroy the recorded judge ballots of an event (the digital counterpart of the score sheets) during or shortly after the event. A minimum duration only: DanceFlow retains them while the event row exists and never deletes them on a timer.

implementation.symbol_or_migration: a00_compod04_events_delete_guard / _compod04_evidence_tables (ballots, marks, ballot events, corrections, attendance)

enforcement_point: Database BEFORE DELETE trigger on public.events (also reached by organizer-delete cascades); not applied to any hosted database yet.

tests.name: OD-04 migration installs ENABLE ALWAYS delete and truncate guards on public.events

interpretation_notes: Open points for the owner: (1) the rule names paper score sheets; whether the digital ballot rows satisfy it, and who keeps any paper original, is not decided. (2) The guard only prevents deletion of the event row; it is not applied to DEV or PROD yet, so nothing is enforced hosted. (3) A superuser can still disable the trigger. Behavior is proven by the local SQL suite (test_T_competition_od04_event_delete_guard.sql), recorded in the PR; status stays requires_interpretation until the owner accepts (1).
